name: get_version
title: Version
description: The silverpoint version this server describes, the Reflex wrapper it is joined with, and the MCP protocol version.

name: list_charts
title: List charts
description: Every chart, optionally filtered by family, intent (trend, compare, rank, part-to-whole, distribution, correlation, flow, hierarchy, change, uncertainty, progress, schedule, kpi, network) or data shape (series, categories, parts, matrix, hierarchy, links, points, distribution, intervals, events, single, field).

name: get_chart
title: Get chart
description: One chart’s catalog entry: data shape, fields, props with defaults, names and imports. With `framework`, only that framework’s name, import and prop spelling.

name: list_components
title: List components
description: Every UI component, optionally filtered by family (ui, composed, overlay) or group.

name: get_component
title: Get component
description: One component’s catalog entry: props, binding, events, slots and states. With `framework`, in that framework’s terms.

name: recommend_chart
title: Recommend a chart
description: Up to five charts for a data shape and an intent, ranked by a reviewed table, with the reasons. Deterministic: no model involved.

name: generate_code
title: Generate code
description: The imports, stylesheets and code that draw one chart or one component in React, Vue, Angular or Reflex, using only names, paths and props the catalog holds. `fields` maps the chart’s data roles to your field names.

name: search_catalog
title: Search the catalog
description: A token search over chart and component names, summaries, prop docs and diagnostic codes, best first; at most 20 hits.

name: validate_props
title: Validate props
description: Builds the chart with the core and returns every diagnostic it raises (code, severity, requirement, message, remedy) and the props it does not declare.

name: render_chart
title: Render a chart
description: The canonical render of one chart as a standalone SVG, the ground’s stylesheet inlined: what every adapter draws for the same props, data, size and id. Without `data`, the demo dataset.

name: check_palette
title: Check a palette
description: The contrast findings of the core’s checkPalette for a preset or a palette of fields, over a substrate given as a hex or by name.
